verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a web-data API platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server applies. The evidence shows a first-party hosted MCP endpoint at mcp.context.dev/mcp and an install guide for connecting AI clients to Context.dev tools for live web and company data. Missing for 10: details on which tools and operations the MCP server exposes, supported clients and MCP-specific auth setup, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the connection works.
